messages:
alex: Root postmortem summary for the Hydra on-prem isolation (prod region eu-west-1). Brief: customer saw TCP flapping on the VPC peering that caused request paths to route to fallback model variant, increasing latency and partial failures.

oncall-bot: Incident RI-2149 created. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/RI-2149

maria: Thanks. Adding follow-ups — we need clear owners and timelines for: networking fix, operator automation, runbook update, customer comms.

samir: I'll take networking fix (diagnose BGP timers and AWS peering jitter). ETA: 2025-04-03. Will open a diagnostic PR with packet captures and config diffs.

alex: @samir TY. Please include exact BGP neighbor config lines. If feasible, test with aggressive keepalive on staging.

jing: I'll own runbook updates + playbook for on-prem peering failures. Draft by 2025-03-28. Specifically will add a quick checklist: 1) verify peering health, 2) cutover plan to dedicated route, 3) rollback steps.

kevin: I'll handle operator automation to detect repeated interface resets and auto-warm a fallback pool. Proposal in RFC: https://rfc.redwood.ai/rfcs/peering-guard.md. ETA: 2025-04-10.

lena-cs: I'll coordinate customer-facing timeline and share interim mitigation steps. Will sync with account team and send an email by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Recurring pattern note: this is 3rd similar onprem peering blip in last 9 months for dedicated customers. We should consider adding a monthly peering stability metric to SLOs. @alex can you add to roadmap?

alex: Added to roadmap board: https://board.redwood.ai/roadmap#peering-stability. Also filing epic RI-2150 to track cross-customer remediations.

samir: Quick log snippet from the affected host:
```
Mar 20 14:12:03 bgpd[1234]: neighbor 10.0.0.1 reset, reason: hold-time expired
Mar 20 14:12:04 kernel: eth0 link down
Mar 20 14:12:05 kernel: eth0 link up
```
I'll attach pcaps to the incident.

jing: For runbook, propose this quick triage command: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/peer.pcap 'host 10.0.0.1'` and `show ip bgp summary` for vendors.

kevin: Automation note: we'll add a detection rule: >3 neighbor resets in 5m -> trigger warm pool and paging. Implement as lambda in operator.

maria: Owners + milestones summary to track in Jira:
- RI-2151 Networking fix (owner: samir, due: 2025-04-03)
- RI-2152 Runbook (owner: jing, due: 2025-03-28)
- RI-2153 Operator automation (owner: kevin, due: 2025-04-10)
- RI-2154 Customer comms (owner: lena-cs, due: 2025-03-25)

alex: I'll run a post-implementation validation on 2025-04-15 to ensure stability (span: 7 days). If flaps recur, escalate to infra oncall for deeper network debugging.

lena-cs: Shared draft to customer: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/hydra-comms.md — awaiting legal review.

samir: quick ask — @maria can we get permission to run a low-impact stress test from customer staging to reproduce jitter? Need sign-off.

maria: I'll loop in security and customer. If customer consents, okay with a scheduled window next week.

alex: Thanks all. Please update the Jira tickets with block/unblock status and link PRs. We'll re-check here on 2025-03-31 for progress.

kevin: :thumbsup:

lena-cs: :eyes:

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: check-in ping on 2025-03-31 15:00 UTC.
